Suppose we write the linear system $$ \begin{bmatrix} 1 \amp -1 \\ 2 \amp -1 \\ -1 \amp 3 \end{bmatrix} \xvec = \threevec{-8}5{-10} $$ as $A\xvec=\bvec$.

Find an orthogonal basis for $\col(A)$.

Find $\bhat$, the orthogonal projection of $\bvec$ onto $\col(A)$.

Find a solution to the linear system $A\xvec = \bhat$.
